kashika: ऋतुशब्दाच् छन्दसि विषये घस् प्रत्ययो भवति तदस्य प्राप्तमित्यस्मिन् विषये। अणोऽपवादः। अ॒यं ते॒ योनि॑र्ऋ॒त्वियः॒ (ऋ०३.२९.१०)॥
kashikaEnglish: घस् (Vedic) after ऋतु for 'season arrived': ऋत्वियः. No Guṇa (ऋतु = पद). Debars अण्.
englishFull:
छन्दसि घस् — In the Vedas, the affix घस् (इय) comes in the sense of "season has come for it" after ऋतु.

This debars अण्.

अयं ते योनिर् ऋत्वियः — "this is your proper seasonal place"

@note[There is no Guṇa by @ref[6.4.146] because ऋतु before घस् gets the designation पद by @ref[1.4.16], and Guṇa (which applies to भ by @ref[1.4.18]) does not apply to पद.]
